# Anthropic — Claude for Startups

Application-based program offering Claude API credits plus upgraded API rate limits. No credit figure is published. Credits are usable only on the first-party Claude API via Claude Console.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - the vendor publishes no amount |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-16 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🤖 AI & ML](../categories/ai.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | credit |
| **Amount** | The vendor publishes no figure |
| **When it ends** | You keep building. Standard API pricing kicks in automatically with no migration. |


### Not covered

- AWS Bedrock
- Google Cloud Vertex AI
- other third-party platforms
- companies that previously received Anthropic startup credits
